Record the pass to .agent-work/commander-315-native/g1b-review/FOWLER_PASS.json (from templates/FOWLER_PASS.template.json), run scripts/verify_fowler_pass.py .agent-work/commander-315-native/g1b-review/FOWLER_PASS.json (it refuses a skipped smell or an unlogged override), then record pass/fail with a finding. There, --authority is the dispatching Commander named in your reviewer handoff (never a string you invent), and --reason is why the path changed. Do NOT silently skip this item.
